header.value: AI-powered end-to-end testing — paste a URL, describe what to test, and let the agent do the rest.

chat-interface.value: Type instructions in plain English. The agent reads your website, plans test cases, executes them live, and streams results back — all inside this conversation.

Hello! I'm your QA Agent. Paste a live website URL above and tell me what you'd like to test — login flows, form validation, navigation, API responses, or anything else. I'll crawl the site, write the test scripts, run them, and hand you a full report.
Test the checkout flow on https://demo.shop.com — make sure add-to-cart, quantity update, and payment form validation all work correctly.

Got it. I'm crawling https://demo.shop.com now. I've identified 3 key flows to test: (1) Add to Cart, (2) Quantity Update, (3) Payment Form Validation. Shall I proceed with all three, or would you like to adjust the scope?
Running 12 test cases across 3 flows using Playwright. 8 passed, 2 failed, 2 pending. See the Test Results tab for the full breakdown.

chat-replay.content: Test the login flow, the checkout process, and make sure all nav links resolve without 404s.
Understood. I'm crawling https://example.com now — mapping all routes, forms, and interactive elements before proposing a test plan.
Step 1: Crawling homepage and extracting all anchor hrefs and form actions. Step 2: Identifying authentication endpoints. Step 3: Mapping checkout funnel pages.

I've identified 3 major test suites: (1) Authentication — login, logout, failed login. (2) Checkout — add to cart, address entry, payment, confirmation. (3) Navigation integrity — 47 links checked for 404s. Shall I proceed with execution?
Yes, run all three suites. Also generate the Playwright script and Excel sheet when done.
Executing 23 test cases across 3 suites. Results, scripts, and Excel sheet will be ready for download once complete.
